script.text: So there is more to you than a crown. I will remember this duel.
Seto departs into the festival crowd. Far above the village, the palace windows burn gold against the night.
Dawn is not far away. You should go while the streets are still quiet.
Come back soon. I want a rematch before you become too important for us!
You return beneath the western arch, carrying the night's victories and a question: why was a temple priest so interested in your cards?
Opening chapter complete. You can return to any duel with the same loaner deck and try a different route to victory.
